headline: Well set for self-funded portfolio expansion

highlights: Given WEWORK’s plans for a phased ramp-up to 10.3msf by Mar’27 (28,000+ new desks in FY27) and 13msf beyond Mar’27, we model 22% revenue and EBITDA CAGR over FY26–29E.
We reiterate BUY with an unchanged TP of INR 933, based on 15x Mar’28E EV/EBITDA.
WEWORK has added 4,500 more desks to its portfolio in Oct’26, taking the figure past its 22,000- seat expansion guidance for H1FY27.

Expect 22% revenue and EBITDA CAGR over FY26–29E We estimate a 22% revenue and IGAAP EBITDA CAGR (post all lease rental payments and brokerage) over FY26–29E, with the IGAAP EBITDA margin expanding 210bps to 21.8% in FY28E vs. 19.7% in FY26, as corporate overheads drop as a percentage of operating revenue.
valuation: We reiterate BUY with an unchanged TP of INR 933, based on 15x Mar’28E EV/EBITDA.
